_meaning: Per work: the text source's short code, the compiler as head transmitter (owner ruling 2026-11-22: the compiler is always a transmitter and heads every chain of his work), and a line of chain convention. compiler_head=false where the compiler is not a transmitter of the reports or is not known from our data; the reason is in compiler_note. Sources: src/lib/sources/registry.ts WORK_CREDITS, chain-reader/tools/prompt_body.md.

sunni:bukhari.convention: Chains open «حدثنا / أخبرنا»; taḥwīl «ح» marks routes that meet. Often ends at a Companion; the Prophet is the end, not a link.

sunni:muslim.convention: Chains open «حدثنا / وحدثنيه»; «ح» and «قالا حدثنا» join routes; «بهذا الإسناد» reuses the previous chain.

sunni:abudawud.convention: Chains open «حدثنا / أخبرنا»; editor glosses sit between dashes; ends at a Companion.

sunni:tirmidhi.convention: Chains open «حدثنا / أخبرنا»; some reports give a second, shorter chain after the matn.

sunni:nasai.convention: Chains open «أخبرنا / أنبأنا»; many reports repeat the previous chain with «بهذا الإسناد».

sunni:ibnmajah.convention: Chains open «حدثنا»; glosses between dashes; ends at a Companion.

sunni:ahmad.convention: The text starts with the source's own chain field (comma = next transmitter, | = another route), a blank line, then the matn. The compiler is not written in the field.

sunni:darimi.convention: As Ahmad: a chain field, a blank line, the matn. The compiler is not written in the field.

sunni:muwatta.compiler_note: The field often names Yahya then Malik; if the text already writes the compiler as a link, that written link stands and no compiler_head is added.
sunni:muwatta.convention: As Ahmad: a chain field, a blank line, the matn.

sunni:shafii.compiler_note: the source ships no chain for these rows
sunni:shafii.convention: The source gives no chain; read only what the text writes.

imami:al-kafi.convention: «عدة من أصحابنا» is an unnamed link; «عنه» opens many reports and points back; «جميعا» joins co-transmitters; the Imam named last is the last link.

imami:man-la-yahduruhu-al-faqih.convention: Many reports open «و روى X عن Y» or «و قال الصادق (ع)» with no «حدثنا»; a report may be advice with no chain.

imami:al-amali-saduq.convention: Opens with the Saduq's own shaykh «حدثنا أبي»; full chains.

imami:al-khisal.convention: Full «حدثنا» chains; English often gives only the first link.

imami:uyun-akhbar-al-rida.convention: Long narratives with a full opening chain; the Imam is al-Rida.

imami:kamal-al-din.convention: Full «حدثنا» chains of the Saduq, long narratives.

imami:kitab-al-ghayba-tusi.convention: «أخبرنا» chains; a report may start in the middle of a chain given earlier.

imami:kamil-al-ziyarat.convention: «حدثني» chains; many routes meet at one name.

imami:kitab-al-zuhd.convention: Short chains; the compiler's own shaykh opens the chain.

imami:kitab-al-mumin.convention: Short chains; the compiler's own shaykh opens the chain.

imami:mujam-al-ahadith-al-mutabara.compiler_note: a modern compilation quoting older books: its compiler is not a transmitter of the reports
imami:mujam-al-ahadith-al-mutabara.convention: Quotes a classical source's chain, usually abridged.

imami:sahifat-al-imam-ali-al-rida.compiler_note: the narrator who carried the Sahifa to the edition is not in our data; no head is added (owner to confirm)
imami:sahifat-al-imam-ali-al-rida.convention: Continuations repeat the opening report's chain; the chain is not in the continuation's text.

ibadi:musnad-rabi.convention: Fixed short chain: Abu 'Ubayda, Jabir b. Zayd, a Companion; «عنه» points back to the previous name.

zaydi:musnad-zayd.compiler_note: whose route carried the Musnad to the edition is not in our data; no head is added (owner to confirm)
zaydi:musnad-zayd.convention: Fixed shape «حدثني زيد بن علي عن أبيه عن جده عن علي»: four links.
